items.maps_query: Shopno Chaya Community Centre, Station Road, Joypurhat
items.notes: Two independent sources confirm the venue is in use. Cybo (aggregator) gives the address, the phone, 4.2 stars from 145 reviews and 'est. 2019'. Desh Rupantor (30 Apr 2026) reports an event held at 'স্বপ্নছায়া কমিউনিটি সেন্টার' and places it on College Road, Joypurhat town. The road differs (Station Road vs College Road), so I rated it medium, not high. Cybo also lists the website shopno-chaya-community-centre.business.site, but Google retired business.site sites in 2024, so I left website empty. Cybo says 'open 24 hours'; that is not meaningful for a hall, so hours are empty. No source gives capacity, AC/non-AC or rent. It also appears in round-1 places.json under other_services.

Only source is a BSS (state news agency) report dated 27 Feb 2026 about an event held the day before at 'পৌর কমিউনিটি সেন্টার' in Joypurhat town. The source gives no street address, phone, capacity, AC info or rent. Upazila set to Sadar because the report places it in Joypurhat town (the Pourashava is in Sadar upazila). The app could add a note telling users to ask Joypurhat Pourashava about booking.

searched_but_not_found: Decorators / event decoration (ডেকোরেটর, বিয়ের স্টেজ): no named Joypurhat decorator in any source I could open. Searches in English and Bangla returned only Indian vendors, and Cybo has no decorator category for Joypurhat.

Wedding/event photographers and cinematography teams: none confirmed as based in Joypurhat. FNF Creative Studio and Kothachitro give no location. Libanza Films has a 'Joypurhat' service-area page, but it is a Dhaka (Gulshan) corporate video company with no local office, so I left it out. 'Joypur Brothers Photography' is in India.

Photo studios: Cybo's English 'photography' page for Joypurhat (3 results) lists only Rongdhonu Studio ('Nowhata', not clearly in Joypurhat) and two Bogura studios, so none were usable. Cybo's 'photography-studio' and Bangla 'ফটোগ্রাফার'/'ফটোগ্রাফি' category pages do not exist for Joypurhat.

Community centres: only the two venues above. I found no convention hall with published capacity, AC/non-AC or rent. Bangla news searches surfaced other event venues, but they are government rooms (DC office conference room, Kalai Press Club) and not rentable halls.

Travel agencies / Hajj-Umrah agencies: none found with a Joypurhat office. Cybo has no travel-agency category page for Joypurhat (the same Bangla slug works for Dhaka, which has 36). hajj.gov.bd agency pages that turned up in search (0855 Jearate Baitullah, 0285 Saim Travels) have Dhaka and Bogura addresses. The hajj.gov.bd agency list URL returns 'Requested Url not valid'.

Electronics / AC / fridge repair: none found. Walton's service-centre list (waltonbd.com/service-center) loads by JavaScript, so it is not readable. The Walton 'Apon Enterprise' showroom in Akkelpur (Financial Express, Jul 2024) is a sales showroom and was left out. gsmarena.com.bd lists 4 Joypurhat mobile showrooms (Hello Joypurhat, Mobile Corner, Rony Mobile Plus, Walton Plaza Akkelpur), but they are sales-only with no service info, so I left them out.
Plumbing/sanitary shops and electricians: no named business found in any readable source.
Motorbike: dealers for Panchbibi and Khetlal were not found (the Bajaj locator lists only Sadar, Kalai and Akkelpur). I did not find independent (non-dealer) motorbike workshops.
Search coverage note: the WebSearch engine is US-centric and mostly returned Indian or unrelated results for Joypurhat and Bangla queries. 59 of 60 searches and about 105 of 150 fetches were used.
blocked_sites: www.cybo.com category pages with query filters (?rating=, ?features=): robots-disallowed

www.cybo.com / yellowpages-bn.cybo.com: most guessed category slugs (community-center, travel-agencies, event-planning, wedding-venues, photography-studio, ট্রাভেল-এজেন্সি, স্থানীয়-সেবা-সমূহ, etc.) returned fetch errors, and postal-code and some BD-biz pages also errored. Only 'photography/' and the Bangla barber/hostel pages loaded, so Cybo looks to have no such categories for Joypurhat.
